systems.owner: Digital Health Agency, both established by the Digital Health Act No. 15 of 2023

note: A reference directory of strategies. For Kenya it lists, as of July 2026: the Digital Health Act No. 15 of 2023 (binding, challenged in the High Court and operating under a Court of Appeal stay), the Kenya Digital Health Strategy 2024-2027 and the Health Information Management Procedures Regulations 2025. The one system it names is not described by function, so its class is empty and the current-plan statement cannot be recorded as a fact against hmis or emr.
